releaseNotes: Strengthens the offline commentary library with 173 unique primary passages and KJV-checked references. Refines the Hebrew, Greek and Aramaic collection to 108 unique original-script lexemes by consolidating duplicate Hesed/Chesed and Nephesh/Nefesh transliterations. Adds explicit Scripture links and contextual word-use notes for 51 entries, with validation against duplicate lexemes and abbreviated references.
